title: GPT-6 Intelligent UI: Answers You Can Tap
status: 2026-10-13: factual claims checked against OpenAI's Oct 7 product article. Automated browser capture returned a Cloudflare challenge and was discarded; visuals are clearly labelled original UI mockups, not screenshots. Option-3 Chatterbox flow required; no on-screen credits.
credits_on_screen: All visual elements are original Reels Studio illustrations. The bicycle interface is explicitly labelled as an illustrative mockup, not a ChatGPT screenshot. Claims and rollout dates come from OpenAI's product article; full URL in post copy.
verify_before_render: OpenAI's 2026-10-07 release says GPT-6 Intelligent UI can combine text, visuals, graphics, tappable buttons, forms, charts, and interactive experiences; the format depends on the question and simple text can be the best response.

OpenAI announced a global rollout to Plus, Pro, Business, and Enterprise on Oct 7, then expansion to Free and Go starting Oct 8. Say 'rollout began/was announced', not that every account has it immediately.
The bicycle mockup is a conceptual illustration, not a captured ChatGPT session. Option 3 Chatterbox Michael continuous-flow voice required.

scenes.heading: GPT-6 INTELLIGENT UI: *ANSWERS YOU CAN TAP*
scenes.say: GPT-6 Intelligent UI can turn a question into an explorable diagram—not just a paragraph.

scenes.heading: MORE THAN *CHAT BUBBLES*
scenes.say: OpenAI says answers can mix text, visuals, forms, charts, and tappable controls.

scenes.heading: A QUESTION BECOMES A *TOOL*
scenes.say: Its launch page shows a seven-speed bicycle split into five connected systems, plus examples like a bill splitter.

scenes.heading: ROLLOUT BEGAN *OCTOBER 7*
scenes.say: Paid plans began rolling out October seventh; OpenAI said Free and Go were next on October eighth.

scenes.heading: THE *USEFUL* CAVEAT
cons: Availability may take time to reach accounts
Some questions work best as plain text
pros: Interactive charts and controls when useful
scenes.say: The rollout may take time to reach accounts. OpenAI says some questions work best as plain text, but when useful it can add interactive controls.

youtube.title: GPT-6 Intelligent UI: Answers You Can Tap
youtube.description:
GPT-6 Intelligent UI lets ChatGPT compose answers using text, visuals, and interactive elements such as diagrams, forms, charts, and tappable controls. OpenAI's launch example explores a seven-speed bicycle; other examples include a bill splitter and calculator. The global rollout began with Plus, Pro, Business, and Enterprise on October 7, 2026, with Free and Go expansion announced for October 8. Availability can vary during a rollout. The interface in this video is an original illustration, not a ChatGPT screenshot.
Source: https://openai.com/index/gpt-6-for-everyone/
